applied.action: Integrated three explicit scope bounds on the ordinal pillar: guarantee is on top-K allocation VALUE not unit-by-unit rank fidelity (tolerates confusing near-threshold bureaux); rho-regularity must be verified on the real French distribution (bad case = clustering at threshold = the competitive peri-urban belt); treatment-effect -> rapport-de-force is an assumed bridge. Added a matching elasticity caveat in 7.B so the 'presque invariant au scenario' claim is testable, not asserted.

Scoped the -60% result: it bounds error when calibrating on a KNOWN local result (validates backtest 2022->2024 and IRIS->bureau interpolation), NOT the jump to 2027 where only the 2022/2024 baseline exists as start of an uncalibrated swing. Rewrote 'exactement l'atout' to 'atout pour les scrutins deja observes'.

Added integrate-by-scoping concession: local anchoring saves the LEVEL/rank of departure but the 2024->2027 MOVEMENT remains a swing exposed to sign-accuracy ~0.5 measured precisely on real baselines; the ordinal output + backtest BOUND this fault, not nullify it.

Made the backtest refutable: added an indicative Spearman rho<0.7 falsification threshold set ex ante, plus a separate test on the competitive/diffusion bureaux subset (where RN geography moves +16-18pts and sign-accuracy bites); below it the architecture is revised not published.

Softened 'disparait' -> 'change de nature': the supply-modelling difficulty does not vanish but shifts from 577 local duel configs to a single national supply uncertainty (wide candidate field, intra-bloc fragmentation).

Merged dialectic #6 and depth #12: flagged 0.89 as a LEFT figure, added the component spread (LFI 0.86, Verts 0.82, PC 0.42) showing non-uniform transferability, and noted the RN europeennes<->presidentielle equivalent is uncited (renvoi 7.C #3).

Added the intention-vs-behaviour gap: RN-NFP duel vague 6 (pre-2nd-round intention) 41/32/23 vs vague 7 (post behaviour) 97/73 within the same Ipsos family; poll-based 2027 matrices are a LOWER BOUND on the real barrage and the delta is itself a correction factor.

Added the 2022 presidential ground-truth matrix as an independent anchor: Melenchon->Macron 42% (17% Le Pen, 41% abst), Pecresse->Macron 53%, vs two-thirds in 2017 — within one pollster family the scrutin-type gap ~ the 20-month erosion gap. Elabe 2027 matrix repositioned as the forward-looking confirmation.

Added the Data for Progress SBC precinct test as direct empirical evidence that point precision and interval calibration decouple at sub-district scale — the empirical counterpart to the Casacuberta-Hardt theory.

Expanded 'cascade de regles' into the four deterministic tiers with counts (~66k classic join -> +1.6k PLM arrondissement -> +400 single-bureau communes -> +300 manual renumbering) and the residual split (~130 REU / ~250 SIE), making the 98.9% reproducible.

Added the Bouba-Olga regional residual (+12.7 PACA to -8.8 Bretagne after socio-demographic controls, R2=0.72) as French empirical warrant that demographics do not exhaust RN geography — justifying the real bureau result over its composition as the load-bearing covariate.

Added elasticite electorale as a dimension orthogonal to lean (538 measures it separately); tied it to 7.B — piecewise swing assumes homogeneous within-bloc elasticity, and rank invariance to scenario is only robust if that holds, so it must be tested (rank variance per bureau under the three scenarios) not assumed.

Added the retrospective French ecological-regression strand (Dolez & Laurent 1997; Charpentier/Freakonometrics 2022) — retrospective and non-spatial-projective, which sharpens the 'no spatial model' void rather than contradicting it.

Added the CEPREMAP June-2025 note: recomposition is not only level drift but a reconfiguration of inter-bloc magnets/repellents (PS/LR space) measured to 2025, reinforcing the 'weight 2022 with a 2024 scrutin' rule.

Anchored the 'reserve d'abstention par bloc' product variable empirically: 2nd-round 2022 demobilisation was bloc-dependent (radical-left/Melenchon electorate abstained most), justifying per-bloc measurement and giving a concrete method (cross bureau turnout with baseline bloc structure).

Linked the Economist rho adjustment to its conceptual source (Gelman et al, 'The Mythical Swing Voter'): apparent poll movement is largely a sample-composition artefact, the most direct theoretical argument for bounded discrete scenarios over continuous recalibration.

Deletion hunks, no regeneration: trimmed the 2-intro escalier/boite-a-outils restatement (already in Reponse directe), cut the 1.B 'engagee des cette section' meta-narration, and removed the redundant thesis-restating closing sentence of 7.D. Kept one strong statement of the metaphor (2.H).
De-duplicated the architecture enumeration in 7.F (verbatim overlap with intro/7.A) into a pointer to 7.A, keeping the Verdict's distinctive framing (no best method; bet on rank not level).

Populated the 'campagnes' facet honestly: piecewise-swing/baseline row marked as the field-targeting backbone (LMP tradition, 1.A); EI, MRP and dynamic-Bayesian rows marked 'aucun usage de campagne documente' rather than left blank. No fabricated campaign use.

Added explicit negative answer: dynamic Bayesian forecasting has no documented sub-national campaign field-targeting use (national/state media products), so the campagnes facet is answered rather than silently omitted.
